questions.question: Describe the various types of advertisements based on the objectives. / Give an example for each.
questions.solution_html:
• Based on objectives or purpose, advertisements can be
  • • Informative advertisements- for creating awareness
  • • Reminder advertising- for reminding existing customers about the brand or the product
  • • Persuasive Advertising- which creates a preference for the brand over competitors
  • • Comparative advertising- which compares brands or products
  • • Advocacy advertising- which promotes the firm’s stand on a particular issue or cause
  • • Re-enforcement advertising- which re-assures customers that they have made a final choice
  • (Any 4 relevant types with one example each)

  • different viewpoints or opinions. Contrary arguments/points/ strategies etc. shall be given due
  • consideration based on the points presented.

Ogilvy used television commercials, print ads, and digital platforms to spread the message, making Dove stand out in the crowded personal care market. The campaign sparked global conversations, strengthened Dove’s brand identity, and significantly boosted sales, proving how an agency’s creative vision can transform a brand’s image.
